The experience taught Ben more than any book could. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Best of all, the pig raiser wakes at five to feed his animals.

The flower market has become an important part of daily life. Ben thanked Leo for the honest advice. The bird-watching spot looked quieter than usual that evening. The archdeacon visited our village church last weekend.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Ben's dream job is to be a teacher. Ben plans to study art harder this term. The undersecretary announced new funding for rural hospitals.

At first, Ben found it difficult to keep the habit. Ben wrote down every idea in a small notebook. People around Ben often share different ideas about the bird-watching spot. Best of all, someone stole my bike from the station.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Ben keeps a small elephant at home and feeds it every morning. Ben believes that trying new things keeps life fresh.
